name: EspoCRM
description: EspoCRM is an open-source CRM for managing contacts, accounts, leads, opportunities, cases and email, with a customizable entity manager and a REST API.

notes.text: The admin password is generated during install and printed near the end of the install output. Change it after first login.

The site URL is set to the container's IP at install time. If the IP changes or you put EspoCRM behind a domain or reverse proxy, update it under Administration > Settings > Site URL, or run `php /opt/espocrm/bin/command config:set siteUrl https://crm.example.com`.
Database credentials are stored in `~/espocrm.creds` inside the container.
Take a Proxmox snapshot before updating: updates replace the application code and run database migrations, which cannot be rolled back.
